messages:
Maya R.: quick sync 1: thinking we need a small, explicit advisory signal in rollout metadata for 'soft binds' so routers can prefer but not lock. goal: let controllers express intent without breaking canaries.
Samir K.: +1 to explicit field. couple questions: how do we represent lifetime coupling (lease vs rollout TTL)? and how should controllers behave on mismatches? reject/accept/annotate?
Jin L.: operators: clients must treat soft-bind as a hint, never as a guarantee. fallback order should be documented: pinned variant -> tenant_default -> global_default -> explicit fallback. if router gets a bind it doesn't honor, record an event.
Priya S.: telemetry: add bind_source (user/controller/auto) and bind_strength (advisory|preferred|hard). we can then build alerts for binds that are being ignored or for long-lived hard binds.
Maya R.: proposed manifest snippet (for discussion) below — using human-friendly JSON only in the thread for clarity:
```json
{
  "model": "open-gpt-xl",
  "variant": "v2",
  "rollout": {
    "bind_type": "soft",           // soft | hard
    "bind_strength": "advisory",  // advisory | preferred | hard
    "bind_source": "controller",  // controller | sdk | ops
    "lease_ms": 1717180800000,     // epoch ms - server canonical
    "fallback_order": ["variant","tenant_default","global_default"]
  }
}
```
Samir K.: prefer lease as epoch ms (server canonical). on mismatch: do not reject updates (will break in-flight canaries). instead accept and set lease_mismatch flag in rollout record and schedule reconciliation job.
Jin L.: agree. client shim semantics: SDKs should honor preferred and hard differently: preferred == try to route but allow fallback; hard == attempt eviction protection and raise immediate error if unavailable (with a documented retry/backoff). advisory == best-effort hint only.
Priya S.: ops playbook: when bind_strength==hard we should create eviction-protection tickets and suppress autoscaler evictions for X minutes. also add alert if a hard bind persists > 24h without explicit owner ack.
Maya R.: controller validation rules: 1) require lease_ms be >= now when creating hard binds; 2) if rollout TTL < lease_ms, controller truncates lease to rollout TTL and emits warning event. 3) annotate record with bind_source and bind_strength.
Samir K.: I'll implement server-side validation and the lease truncation logic. PR will include schema and swagger updates. target: EOD Thursday.
Jin L.: I'll add SDK behavior docs and a small shim that surfaces bind_strength to application-level metrics.
Priya S.: I'll add telemetry panels: 1) binds by strength over time, 2) lease_mismatch rate, 3) long-lived hard binds. will post dashboards link here.

Samir K.: ack
Jin L.: ack
Priya S.: ack
